reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Shared Paintbrush 009
materials.text: We have two paintbrushes. The wide brush is for the wall sign. The thin brush is for names. Kim uses the wide one first, then Sam. Wash a brush before changing colours. Leave clean brushes lying flat on the towel. Do not put them in the pencil box.

questions.prompt: A friend needs to paint a small name. You say, "____"
options: Use a ruler to paint it.
questions.explanation: A姓名用细笔；B宽笔指定画墙面标牌；C尺不是材料中用于写名的画笔。

questions.prompt: Sam asks for the wide brush while Kim is using it. You say, "____"
options: You can use it after Kim.
No one may use it today.
questions.explanation: B顺序Kim后Sam；A夺取违先后；C两人均可用非全禁。

questions.prompt: A friend changes from red paint to blue. You say, "____"
options: Put the red brush in the blue paint now.
Put the brush in your pocket.
questions.explanation: C换色前洗；A直接混色违规则；B衣袋非清洗。

questions.prompt: A friend stands a clean brush on its tip. You say, "____"
options: Lay it flat on the towel.
Stand it in the pencil box.
questions.explanation: A干净笔平放毛巾；B铅笔盒明确禁放；C丢毛巾无要求。

questions.prompt: A friend opens the pencil box to store the brushes. You say, "____"
options: Put them in with the pencils.
Hide them under the wall sign.
questions.explanation: B刷子留毛巾；A入铅笔盒违规则；C藏标牌下无依据。

units.title: 夜间自然观察的手电筒

materials.title: Night Walk Torches 009
materials.text: We take a short night walk with the teacher. Stay with your partner. Point your torch at the path, not at faces. The teacher walks first. Do not touch little animals. At the wooden bridge, stop and wait for the teacher’s hand sign. Then cross one pair at a time.

questions.prompt: Your partner walks away alone. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A夜行应结伴不单走；B更远离同伴与规则相反；C独自在家等待不是当前步行中与同伴同行。

questions.prompt: A friend shines a torch in your eyes. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B灯照路非脸；A违禁；C鞋内不能照路线。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to walk ahead of the teacher. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C教师先行；A抢前相反；B攀人非安排。

questions.prompt: A friend reaches for a small frog. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A只看不碰；B装袋需触碰且干扰动物；C用手电触碰也违反不触碰要求。

questions.prompt: Your pair reaches the bridge before the hand sign. You say, "____"
options: Wait here for the teacher’s sign.
questions.explanation: B桥前待信号且逐对过；A提前全体过违两条；C下水非路线。

materials.title: Silent Film Evening 009
materials.text: Our family watches a short film. There are no spoken words. A man looks for his hat. His dog has the hat under a chair. My brother laughs because he sees it first. Mum puts music on, but Dad turns it off. He wants to hear the music in the film. At the end, the dog brings the hat to the man. We all clap.

questions.prompt: People speak in the film.
questions.explanation: B正确：no spoken words；A漏读否定。

questions.prompt: The man is looking for his hat.
questions.explanation: A正确：looks for hat；B否认主线动作。

questions.prompt: The hat is under a chair with the dog.
questions.explanation: A正确：dog has hat under chair；B与藏处相反。

questions.prompt: Dad turns off the film because he dislikes it.
questions.explanation: B正确：关的是妈妈放的音乐，为听影片音乐；A错对象和原因。

questions.prompt: The dog gives the hat back at the end.
questions.explanation: A正确：末尾狗把帽带给男子；B否认结局。

materials.title: Treasure Map Arrow 009
materials.text: My cousin makes a treasure map for me. The first arrow points to the sofa. I find a note under a cushion. It says, "Look beside the shoes." I go to the door. There is a second note in a small boot. It says, "Your treasure is where we keep cold food." I open the fridge. A little box of strawberries is waiting for me.

questions.prompt: The first arrow points to the fridge.
questions.explanation: B正确：第一箭头指sofa；A将最终地点当首站。

questions.prompt: The first note is under a cushion.
questions.explanation: A正确：under cushion明确；B否认位置。

questions.prompt: The second note is in a large coat.
questions.explanation: B正确：small boot里；A把靴子改外套且大变小。

questions.prompt: The final clue sends the writer to the fridge.
questions.explanation: A正确：冷藏食物处，作者打开fridge；B否认文本中的线索结果。

questions.prompt: The treasure is a box of strawberries.
questions.explanation: A正确：little box strawberries为最终奖品；B与结局相反。

materials.title: Robot Battery Box 009
materials.text: The robot club has a box for used batteries. A red sticker means a battery is empty. A blue sticker means it still has some power. Before the lesson, Noah finds a battery with no sticker. He does not guess. He gives it to the teacher to check. The teacher tests it and puts a blue sticker on it. Pupils never mix old and new batteries in one robot. At the end, empty batteries go into a special collection container. They do not go into the classroom paper bin.

questions.prompt: What does a red sticker mean?
questions.explanation: A红签电池没电；B新旧非红签含义；C与机器人颜色无关。

questions.prompt: What does Noah do with the unmarked battery?
options: Throw it in the paper bin.
Ask the teacher to check it.
Put it in a robot without checking.
questions.explanation: B不猜而交教师；A废纸桶不许可；C未检测即用非动作。

questions.prompt: What sticker does the teacher add after testing?
questions.explanation: C实测后蓝签；A确有贴签；B非本次结果。

questions.prompt: Which batteries should not be mixed in one robot?
options: Two tested batteries with blue stickers.
questions.explanation: A明确不混新旧电池；B两个新电池没有被该规则禁止；C同为检测后蓝签不是原文明确禁止的组合，蓝签本身不说明新旧。

questions.prompt: Where do empty batteries go?
questions.explanation: B专用收集容器；A明禁废纸桶；C沙下无安排。

materials.title: Garden Picnic Rain Cover 009
materials.text: The class plans to eat lunch in the garden. Rain is possible, so the caretaker puts a cover over two tables. One corner hangs too low. Water gathers there. A pupil wants to push it up with a chair. The caretaker asks everyone to stand back and uses a long pole to empty the water safely. Then he raises the corner and checks the ropes. We eat in the hall while he works. After lunch, the tables are dry, but we do not move back because the meal is over.

questions.prompt: The caretaker covers two garden tables.
questions.explanation: A正确：cover over two tables；B否认数量和准备。

questions.prompt: Water gathers at a low corner of the cover.
questions.explanation: A正确：corner too low，water gathers there；B否认问题。

questions.prompt: The pupil uses a chair to push the cover up.
questions.explanation: B正确：只是想法，管理员让退开并用长杆处理；A把未采纳想法当执行。

questions.prompt: The class eats in the garden while the caretaker works.
questions.explanation: B正确：吃在hall；A把原计划当临时实际安排。

questions.prompt: The class stays in the hall until the meal is over.
questions.explanation: A正确：午餐在厅完成，之后不搬回；B与完成进餐地点冲突。

materials.title: Market Cup Reuse 009
materials.text: At the school market, the tea stall used washable cups. Visitors paid ten yuan for tea and another five yuan as a cup deposit. The five yuan was returned when the cup came back. A sign explained the two amounts separately. At first, the return tray stood behind the stall and was hard to find. Some visitors left cups on benches. The organisers moved the tray beside the main exit and added an arrow sign. More cups came back after that, but the team did not say the sign alone caused the change. A volunteer had also begun collecting cups from tables. The final report described both changes.

questions.prompt: Visitors paid a total of fifteen yuan at first for tea and a cup deposit.
questions.explanation: A正确：茶十加押金五，共十五；B否认明确金额组合。

questions.prompt: The cup deposit was kept even when a visitor returned the cup.
questions.explanation: B正确：杯回押金返；A将可退押金当永久收费。

questions.prompt: The first return tray was easy for all visitors to see.
questions.explanation: B正确：behind stall hard to find；A夸为所有人易见。

questions.prompt: The tray was moved beside the main exit.
questions.explanation: A正确：move beside main exit；B否认位置改进。

questions.prompt: The report recognised more than one possible reason for increased returns.
questions.explanation: A正确：箭头和志愿者收桌杯同时改变，报告两者；B与审慎说明相反。

units.title: 老街步行导览的替代路线

materials.title: Walking Tour Route Note 009
materials.text:
Message for families joining Saturday’s old-street walk:
The narrow lane beside the clock shop is closed for building work. Our meeting point remains the library steps at 10:00. The guide will lead the group along River Road instead. The walk is still one hour long, but it now ends at the bridge, not at the market square. There are no public toilets on River Road, so use the library toilets before we leave. Children must stay with an adult. Bring a hat and water; the riverside has little shade. If heavy rain is forecast on Friday evening, we will send a cancellation message. A cloudy sky alone does not cancel the walk.

questions.prompt: Where should families meet?
questions.explanation: B集合点仍图书馆台阶；A原终点、D新终点不作起点；C钟店非集合点。

questions.prompt: Why is the route changing?
options: The narrow lane has building work.
Families have asked for a longer walk.
questions.explanation: C窄巷施工关闭；A桥仍终点；B图书馆仍可用厕；D时长未增。

questions.prompt: Where will the walk now finish?
questions.explanation: A新终点bridge；B原终点取消；C馆内台、D厕所非终点。

questions.prompt: Why should families use the library toilets first?
options: The market toilets are too colourful.
There are no public toilets along River Road.
questions.explanation: D替代路无公厕；A售厕票、C颜色均无据；B仍一小时非整日。

questions.prompt: Which weather condition may lead to cancellation?
questions.explanation: B周五预报暴雨才发取消消息；A云明确不够；C晴天、D凉风非条件。

units.title: 学习工具与信息词的分类

materials.title: Useful Words Classification 009
materials.text: Choose the word that fits the precise description. Each question has one correct answer. Think about the word’s meaning in the stated setting.

questions.prompt: Which word names a record showing what was paid for a purchase?
questions.explanation: A receipt收据记录购买付款；B forecast预测，C recipe食谱，均非付款记录。

questions.prompt: Which word names a person trained to care for books and help readers find them?
questions.explanation: B librarian图书管理员；A机械师修机器；C飞行员操纵飞机。

questions.prompt: Which word describes something that can be used again many times?
questions.explanation: C reusable可重复使用；A missing丢失，B silent无声均不表示可重复用。

questions.prompt: Which word names information that tells how to do a task?
questions.explanation: A instructions操作说明；B decorations装饰，C destinations目的地不提供做事步骤。

questions.prompt: Which word describes a route that avoids an obstacle by going another way?
questions.explanation: B detour绕行路线；A收据和C日记均非绕开障碍的路线。

materials.title: Family Recipe Record 009
materials.text:
For a family project, I asked Grandma how she made her soup. She usually judged amounts by looking, so her first instructions said "a little salt" and "enough water." I wrote them down, then realised my cousin could not follow them confidently. We cooked a second pot together and measured the ingredients before adding them. The written recipe became clearer, but Grandma warned that vegetables could contain different amounts of water.
We added a note telling readers to check the soup near the end and adjust it with an adult’s help. I also recorded that Grandma sometimes used beans when pumpkins were unavailable. We kept that as an alternative, not as an ingredient to add to every pot. Our final page showed one tested version and explained where choices were still needed.

questions.prompt: Grandma’s first instructions gave an exact measurement for every ingredient.
questions.explanation: B正确：a little与enough非精确量；A把原先模糊说明说成全精确。

questions.prompt: The writer measured ingredients while cooking a second pot with Grandma.
questions.explanation: A正确：second pot together并测量；B否认改进过程。

questions.prompt: The clearer recipe removed every need for judgement.
questions.explanation: B正确：蔬菜水量不同仍需末尾检查；A把更清楚夸为无需判断。

questions.prompt: Beans were recorded as an alternative when pumpkins were unavailable.
questions.explanation: A正确：缺南瓜时豆类替代；B否认替代条件。

questions.prompt: The final recipe required beans and pumpkins in every pot.
questions.explanation: B正确：替代并非每锅都加；A把可选关系变成必加两者。
